Question_text: Ahmed's internet provider offers two payment schemes. Scheme A : $30 per month for unlimited use. Scheme B : $0.05 per minute on weekdays and $0.03 per minute at the weekend. Find the cost per month, in dollars, for Scheme B and decide which payment scheme is cheaper.
